whatChanged: ADVANCED: Reuters reports a senior source denying the ~$400bn AstraZeneca/Bristol Myers Squibb combination ever existed, ending the merger speculation the FT started (azn-bmy-merger-talks) (rumored → abandoned)
NEW: Bodycote confirms a possible up-to-915p-a-share (~GBP1.56bn) cash offer from CVC Advisers, with confirmatory due diligence open and a 2 September Rule 2.6 deadline (boy-cvc-takeover-bid)

NEW: Veritas Capital tables a competing up-to-914p-a-share proposal for Bodycote that the board would also recommend, turning the FTSE 250 heat-treatment specialist into a two-sponsor auction (boy-veritas-takeover-bid)

NEW: ContextLogic agrees to buy specialty chemicals maker gChem from EagleTree Capital for $850m cash, funded partly by a $650m rights offering backstopped by Abrams Capital and BC Partners (logc-gchem-acquisition)
NEW: ENEOS Holdings agrees to acquire TPC Group at ~$1.3bn enterprise value, taking the group to the world's third-largest butadiene capacity (eneos-tpc-group-acquisition)

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: The London market keeps losing control of its own constituents to overseas and private capital, and this week it reached the FTSE 250's industrials. Bodycote, the largest independent thermal-processing network in the West, has confirmed twin cash approaches a penny apart -- CVC at up to 915p (boy-cvc-takeover-bid) and Veritas Capital at up to 914p (boy-veritas-takeover-bid) -- with the board prepared to recommend either. Above it, Apollo's 715p-a-share, GBP5.7bn cash offer for easyJet is firm and board-recommended after Castlelake walked away (ezj-apollo-takeover), Prologis has a recommended Rule 2.7 offer valuing Segro at ~GBP14.3bn that would remove one of the FTSE 100's largest REITs from the LSE (pld-sgro-takeover-bid), and CD&R-owned OCS Group's agreed GBP3.1bn takeover will delist facilities-management leader Mitie entirely (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsor-, sovereign- and strategic-led buyouts keep pulling listed names off public markets: Nielsen will take DoubleVerify private at $13.60 a share in cash (dv-nielsen-acquisition), Apollo's easyJet offer went firm (ezj-apollo-takeover), KKR has a signed $127-a-share agreement for Integer Holdings (itgr-kkr-takeover), and the $55bn PIF-Silver Lake-Affinity take-private of EA has completed (ea-pif-consortium-take-private). Still unresolved: CVC and Veritas Capital are running competing GBP1.56bn proposals for Bodycote to a 2 September deadline (boy-cvc-takeover-bid, boy-veritas-takeover-bid), Grant Thornton and New Mountain Capital's $5bn deal for CBIZ runs a go-shop to August 27 (cbz-grant-thornton-acquisition), Pacific Equity Partners' SG Fleet vehicle bids A$3.60 a share for FleetPartners (fpr-sgfleet-takeover-bid), Steel Partners' $16.75-a-share bid for InMode is fought through both the Haifa court and the AGM ballot (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT keeps raising for Perpetual and now has limited due-diligence access (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's EUR38-a-share tender for Hugo Boss is unconditional with an additional acceptance period to August 13 (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), Sazerac's ~$15bn approach for Brown-Forman has been rejected as not actionable (bfb-sazerac-takeover-bid), and ADW Capital's $18-a-share proposal for Driven Brands was dismissed as lacking a credible basis (drvn-adw-capital-takeover-bid).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital keeps pouring into the physical layer of AI compute, and the deals increasingly reach past the racks into the fuel and the fabric feeding them. Williams is paying up to $5.5bn for Momentum Midstream explicitly to connect Haynesville gas to Gulf Coast LNG and power demand (wmb-momentum-midstream-acquisition), while Prysmian pays ~$3.8bn for Atkore's conduit and cable-management business (atkr-prysmian-acquisition) and Everus bought modular electrical specialist Epsilon Industries (ecg-epsilon-acquisition). At the compute layer, Amazon's 2026 capex guide is up to ~$220bn with capacity constrained into 2027 (amzn-capex-raise-2026) and Alphabet's to as much as $205bn (googl-capex-raise-2026); Nvidia is in talks to backstop ~$250bn of financing for OpenAI's 10GW Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), has an equity-plus-Vera-Rubin pact with Safe Superintelligence (nvda-ssi-partnership), is scaling the $10bn Naver AI factory to 200MW with Brookfield capital (naver-nvda-ai-factory-partnership), and will co-design orbital compute payloads with SpaceX (spcx-nvda-starmind-partnership). Orange and Morrison are building a EUR3bn, 400MW French JV (ora-morrison-datacenter-jv), NVIDIA prepaid $1.5bn for packaging capacity at Amkor (amkr-nvidia-packaging-partnership), Verizon signed a $1bn dark-fiber deal with Google (vz-google-fiber-partnership), Samsung agreed a ~$200bn memory and foundry MOU with Broadcom (samsungelec-avgo-chip-partnership), SK hynix has a long-term HBM pact with NVIDIA (skhynix-nvda-ai-partnership), and Doosan took control of Korea's sole wafer maker SK Siltron (doosan-sksiltron-acquisition).

themes.label: Chipmakers funding or locking in the customers that buy their chips
themes.note: Vendor financing and exclusivity remain the standard shape of frontier-AI deals, and both concentrate risk on the supplier's side of the trade: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee ~$250bn of lease and debt financing for OpenAI's Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), took a reported ~$5bn equity stake in pre-revenue Safe Superintelligence alongside a compute commitment (nvda-ssi-partnership), is buying ~4.5% of Naver via a ~$1bn share issue tied to a 200MW AI factory (naver-nvda-ai-factory-partnership), and has secured an exclusive commitment from SpaceX to build its AI infrastructure on NVIDIA platforms (spcx-nvda-starmind-partnership), while AMD is investing up to $5bn in Anthropic against a tens-of-billions MI450 purchase commitment (amd-anthropic-chip-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep being decided in court rather than at closing. Delaware's Chancery Court has voided Verisk's walk-away from its $2.35bn AccuLynx purchase, ruling the buyer's own willful conduct broke the closing condition and ordering it to try again -- while the FTC review that triggered the termination is still unfinished (vrsk-acculynx-acquisition). The signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger will not close until five days after a 12-day antitrust trial set for March 2, 2027, with Paramount owing Warner holders ~$7m a day from September 30, 2026 in the meantime (psky-wbd-acquisition). InMode's special committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Haifa court's ruling on the competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
